Jasmine Kaur  
Tel Aviv, Israel | +972 54 321 6789 | jasmin.kaur.dev | linkedin.com/in/jasminekaur  

Over the past three years, I’ve specialized in building scalable mobile solutions for e-commerce platforms, focusing on cross-platform frameworks and performance optimization. At ShopFlow Technologies, I architected Flutter-based applications that synchronize real-time inventory data across thousands of devices, achieving a 98% app store approval rate and 4.8/5 user satisfaction. Prior to that, I refactored VistaCart’s Android app using Kotlin, reducing deployment time by 40% through CI/CD integration. My work at EcomPulse Solutions involved developing React Native apps with seamless payment gateway integrations, supporting over 10,000 active users. These experiences honed my ability to balance technical rigor with user-centric design, ensuring robust, maintainable codebases that align with business goals.  

Technical proficiency spans mobile development, cloud integration, and system architecture. I’ve led Android app refactoring projects, leveraging Kotlin’s null safety and coroutines to streamline complex workflows. My Flutter expertise includes building high-performance e-commerce apps with real-time data sync, optimizing UI responsiveness for varying network conditions. I’ve implemented CI/CD pipelines that automate testing and deployment, reducing manual intervention and accelerating release cycles. REST API design is central to my workflow, with ownership of endpoints that power inventory tracking and order fulfillment systems. State management strategies, such as Riverpod and Provider, ensure consistent data flow across multi-platform apps. While primarily focused on Android and Flutter, I’ve also contributed to iOS development using Swift, ensuring cross-platform consistency in user experiences.  

Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, University of Toronto, 2021. Graduated with honors, emphasizing software engineering principles and distributed systems.  

Fluent in English and Hebrew, with intermediate proficiency in Arabic. My bilingual capabilities support collaboration with international teams and local stakeholders.  

Certified in Google’s Android Developer Professional Certificate and Flutter for Web and Desktop. These credentials validate my ability to design, develop, and deploy scalable mobile applications across diverse platforms.  

Recognized for delivering high-impact mobile solutions, including a 4.8/5 rating for ShopFlow’s e-commerce app and a 98% approval rate for its app store submissions. My work at VistaCart earned acknowledgment for optimizing deployment pipelines, directly contributing to faster time-to-market for critical features. These achievements reflect a commitment to measurable outcomes and continuous improvement in mobile development practices.
